_comment: What docs/features/verify-tests.md (8a-1, refreshed 2026-10-16) says `spec verify --tests` gives on this corpus (P10, TE-1); shared with 8b (docs/features/tested-evidence.md). Built from the spec and the canon (code-identity.md 'Units and qpath', symbol-names.md 'Discriminator', code-targets.md 'Target table', code-bindings.md 'Rust binding', 'ID state', 'Revision state'), never from the command's output. The tests copy the corpus to a scratch repository (this file left out), write a fake self-terminating runner at `scripts/run-test` there and commit it as `the runner`; the corpus itself is never built. `tests`: every @verifies binding, in output order (file, then symbol, bytes), its set nodes by ID bytes, the value of each placeholder (P5: from the structured name, never by splitting the qpath), `argv` under the corpus' `[verify] tests` (null: not run), `reason` of one not run. `run_order`: each distinct argv once, by its first test (`peak_is_capped`'s cfg twins share one). `probes`: one per distinct probe argv ({test} = the probe name), all before any test. `listing`: the stderr lines before the question (step 7); `question`: `<template>`, `<worktree>`, `<commit>` stand for the scratch repository's. `all_passed`: what the run gives when every runnable test passes. `readings`: points of this file to confirm once the code lands.

nodes.note: no binding: never reported; with CONE-03 it gives the corpus the five documents the store's own-text oracle wants
the document: contains KILN-RAMP, KILN-HOLD, KILN-COOL; no @verifies binding of its own

listing: not run | crates/kiln/src/cool.rs | item crates/kiln::cool::tests::cooling_stops_at_zero | KILN-COOL | node not verifiable
not run | crates/kiln/tests/schedule.rs | module crates/kiln::test:schedule | KILN-HOLD | module
question: run 4 bound tests of 4 nodes as <template> (timeout 600 s each) in <worktree> on main at <commit>, then commit their evidence to spec.lock? [y/N]

stdout: not run | crates/kiln/src/cool.rs | item crates/kiln::cool::tests::cooling_stops_at_zero | KILN-COOL | node not verifiable
not run | crates/kiln/tests/schedule.rs | module crates/kiln::test:schedule | KILN-HOLD | module
verify --tests: unverified: 5 nodes (4 verified, 0 failed, 1 not verifiable, 0 no runnable test); 7 tests (5 passed, 0 failed, 0 timed out, 2 not run)

readings: R1 the cfg twins' discriminators: the chain is the enclosing `mod tests`' `test` then the item's own, joined by `,` (symbol-names.md 'Discriminator' rule 1): `cfg(test,unix)`, `cfg(test,not(unix))`.
R2 probes: one run per distinct probe argv (4 test argv give 2), all before the first test; `counts.probes` is that number.
R3 JSON `argv` is the expanded template as written (element 0 `scripts/run-test`, not joined to the root): TE-7 wants one JSON from two roots; `command` is the template as a list.
R4 the module binding and a test of an unverifiable node are listed rows (`not run`) and counted in `tests`; `argv` of a row not run is not pinned.
R5 a test's nodes are its set nodes by ID bytes, joined by `, `; node lines by ID bytes (upper case before `glaze-check/`).
R6 `KILN-COOL`'s only refusal is the `@implements KILN-COOL@1` marker's `spec_ahead` (rev 2 written), a refusal 5b-1 keeps.

R7 (docs/features/tested-evidence.md 'The run's write') the passing run commits its evidence: after 8a's summary a `lock | added | <node>` line per block by node bytes, then `committed <evidence>` (`<evidence>` the evidence commit, `HEAD`'s child); `lock_file` the bytes it writes; `commit` stays the run's `HEAD`; no block for `KILN-COOL`.
